purpose: Evaluate continuous temporal background features as a SAM2 dense mask prompt on the same selected seq11 frames where extreme-point prompts failed.
inputs: Use fixed, previously saved automatic target masks and temporal FPN/RGB score maps from the reproducible seq11 temporal background diagnostic; no labels enter prompt construction. The same target-mask-derived box is used by every arm.
arms: For SAM2's existing 256x256 mask prompt, area-resize the binary target prediction and map its range linearly to -4..4 logits. Compare this fixed prior alone with that prior plus one fixed globally standardized FPN foreground score, FPN foreground-minus-background score, RGB contrast score, or fixed-seed spatially shuffled FPN contrast score. The score coefficient is fixed at 1; no score threshold, confidence gate, learned head, re-detection or propagation modification is used. The unmodified stored Lean mask is the primary reference.
validation: Two independent label-free gates cover frames 51 and 172, with identical prompts and output masks. Verify source score-map and mask hashes, predictor identity, output dimensions and unchanged weights. Labels are opened only by a separate audit after every pilot prediction is saved.
limitations: The binary -4..4 mask prior is an approximation, not the true previous SAM logits. The images and frames were chosen after extensive inspection and the method was proposed after previous failures; this is a small retrospective diagnostic, not an independent test, trained feature module or evidence of improved propagation.
